Legal information.

Website notices, privacy and use of this preview.

About this website

This website is an independent redesign preview prepared by Triple Four Studio for Synboli. It presents a proposed design direction using information from Synboli’s public website. It is not Synboli’s official website or a statement of an agreed commercial relationship.

Website content

The material on this website is provided for information and design evaluation. Application examples describe the areas presented by Synboli and are not guarantees of performance, suitability or availability. Scientific content and commercial details should be confirmed with the company before relying on them.

The preview does not create a contract, quotation or commitment to supply a product or service. Any project terms would need to be agreed separately.

Intellectual property and photography

Synboli’s name and the names and logos of supporting organisations belong to their respective owners. Their inclusion identifies the company and its research and support ecosystem.

The photographs are illustrative stock images. They do not depict Synboli’s employees, facilities or validated products. Photography sources and licence information are available on the image credits page. Image rights remain with their respective owners.

Privacy and contact forms

The enquiry form creates an email draft in your own email application. Entering information in the form does not submit it to a website database or send an email automatically. If you choose to send the draft, your email provider and the recipient process the message.

Please avoid including confidential technical, personal or commercially sensitive information in an initial enquiry.

Analytics and hosting

This website is hosted on Vercel and uses Vercel Web Analytics to understand aggregate traffic. The analytics data can include pages visited, referring websites, approximate location, browser, operating system and device type. Vercel Web Analytics does not use third-party tracking cookies.

The site does not use advertising trackers or collect contact-form contents through analytics. Hosting providers may process technical request information to deliver and secure the website.

External links

Links to third-party websites are provided for reference. Those websites operate under their own terms and privacy policies. Their content and services are managed by their respective operators.

Access and search visibility

This preview is publicly accessible by its URL. It includes instructions asking search engines not to index its pages. These instructions do not restrict access or make the website private.

Questions about this preview

For questions about the design, website operation or this notice, contact Triple Four Studio.
